narrative.overview:
Ambixous looks like a creative studio working after hours: a near-black canvas (Electric Ink) with one light switched on, a neon lime that marks where to look and what to do next. Between dark stretches the page opens into pale light-ash sections, the daylight of the audience, where white cards carry the proof. The system is credible before it is playful: confident Sora type, hairline borders, real photographs of real people, and numbers that match the live site.

It serves two audiences equally: students and creators on phones, and brands deciding whether to hire the studio. So every screen has to read in a glance on a mid-range phone over mobile data, and look like a practitioner-grade company on a client's laptop.
keyCharacteristics: Dark canvas by default, pale light-ash sections for proof and information.
One accent at a time: neon lime leads; blue and coral support.
Display type is huge, heavy and tightly tracked; everything else is calm.
Tactile controls: solid lime buttons that lift on hover, generous radii, real soft shadows on light cards.
Accent colours are for fills, borders and large text; small text on light surfaces uses the darker ink variants.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: One accent leads any given view. Neon is the action and the focus; blue and coral support it. If everything glows, nothing is the call to action.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Light Rule
rules.body: The bright accents never carry small text on white or light-ash (they fall to 1.2 to 2.8:1). Use the matching ink token for text and keep the bright value for fills, borders and large display type.

rules.name: The Opacity Floor Rule
rules.body: Muted text on dark is warm-white at 55% or more, or slate-gray at 80% or more, so it stays above 4.5:1. Anything fainter is decorative and must be hidden from assistive tech.

rules.name: The Tight Top Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows (-0.025em at display, -0.06em on oversized numerals) and opens as size shrinks (+0.32em on labels).

rules.name: The Numerals Rule
rules.body: Counters and stats use tabular figures so they do not shift while counting up.

rules.name: The Lift On Response Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are still at rest; elevation increases only as a response to hover, focus or selection.

dos: Do let one accent lead each view; neon marks the action and focus.
Do use Neon Ink, Blue Ink and Coral Ink for any accent-coloured text smaller than large display on white or light-ash.
Do keep muted text on dark at 55% warm-white or slate-gray at 80% or above.
Do keep every informational label legible on a phone (12px or larger) and every primary tap target at least 44px tall.
Do keep the real figure in the markup for any animated number, and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep numbers, dates and facts identical to the live site, and update the page's metadata and JSON-LD in the same change.
Do put the Ambixous logo on every page, in the header and footer.
donts: Don't set bright Neon, Blue or Coral as small text on white or light-ash.
Don't nest a button inside a link (or the reverse); use one interactive element.
Don't hide the focus ring; focus-visible styling is required on every interactive element.
Don't add decorative weight on mobile: unoptimised hero images, extra web fonts, or third-party embeds that load before they are asked for.
Don't invent proof: no placeholder logos, quotes, case studies or statistics.
